title: Expo — React Native
description: React Native + TypeScript with Expo Router and NativeWind. The preview runs in your browser via Expo web — no Xcode or Android SDK needed. Device and store builds are a separate step.
stack: React Native + TypeScript on Expo (managed workflow), Expo Router for file-based navigation, and NativeWind (Tailwind for React Native). Previewed in the browser via Expo web (Metro static rendering).
